payload.title: Research: bridge the spec to Claude Code's native task list (Agent Teams)?
payload.body:
Decide if the TASKS.md spec should map to Claude Code's native task list (Agent Teams). Compare fields, claims, and dependencies. Write the finding to docs/research/. Source idea: the minsky TASKS item investigate-claude-native-task-standard; see https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/TASKS.md.
- **Hypothesis**: a written mapping shows whether the spec can sync both ways; the answer is a clear yes or no with the field gaps counted.
- **Measurement**: ls docs/research/ | rg native-task; the doc lists every spec field as mapped, lossy, or missing
- **Success**: one research doc with a go or no-go and a field table covering all spec fields.
- **Pivot**: if the native format has no stable public schema, record no-go and revisit at the next Claude Code release.
- **Anchor**: Claude Code docs, Agent Teams (2026).
